payload.author: claude
payload.body: Merged to main (e49d63e) via fast-forward. Added ts-postgres CI job (postgres:16 service container) running the FR-22 migration runner against a live DB via FRICK_DATABASE_URL, plus a root test:pg script. Verified locally against postgres:16 in Docker: all 17 migrations apply, full pg-migrations suite 15/15 green — the translated SQL (tsvector/GENERATED/BYTEA) actually executes now, not just static parity. SCOPE NOTE: scoped to the migration-runner file only; the full @frick/server suite on Postgres stays blocked on FR-23 (per-store port). The FR-23 blocked_by relation on this ticket is for that wider matrix; the runner slice is delivered.
